orchestrator.description: Owns the spec, judges implementation against it, validates

steps.label: Specify
steps.description: Write a formal specification from the brief. Define interfaces, contracts, expected behavior. Write to context/spec.md. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Implement
steps.description: Read context/spec.md. Build to the specification. The spec is the source of truth. Commit frequently. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Validate
steps.description: Read context/spec.md. Test the implementation against every contract. Write context/validation-report.md. Update context/status.md.
